issue.title: Hide unsupported DOCSIS errors in Before/After Comparison

summary.text: A test reproduced the bug and passes after the fix, with no regressions or breaking inputs found; the one behaviour change in comparison.routes._aggregate_period was judged intended, but the guard stage reported the fix as not guarded and mutation testing fell short of L2. Next, check that the regression test would catch a reverted or weakened fix, especially that unsupported error counters stay…

labels.label: intended
labels.reason: The issue asks the comparison view to hide the errors chart when error counters are unsupported. Adding the errors_supported flags (all False) to the empty-period result is additive and keeps the existing keys. The 0 totals are unchanged, so the untouched test on this input should still hold.
